title: Consolidate duplicate SDF evaluation paths
description: Audit and simplify SdfProgramEvaluator's duplicated execution paths and the legacy SdfSamplingJob now that DensityGrid uses SdfSamplingRowBatchJob. Preserve the managed/reference oracle and Burst-compatible hot path as explicit roles, but eliminate dead or equivalent traversal code where a single implementation can safely own the semantics. Add parity tests before removal and do not collapse reference and production paths so aggressively that the reference oracle loses independence.

comments.author: ChatGPT
comments.body: Current-head static audit 2026-09-12: SdfProgram contains both EvaluateOperation/EvaluateSubtree traversal variants and a legacy SdfSamplingJob while DensityGrid's active production path is SdfSamplingRowBatchJob. Simplification is desirable, but only after independent reference parity is preserved.
